'''House Indupar''' was an [[Ancient Houses|Ancient House]] that headed the [[Induparan Monarchy]] and ruled over the [[Induparan Crown Worlds]]. The House was led by [[King/Legends|King]] [[Dahon Indupar]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In the [[Ec Pand system/Legends|Ec Pand system]] (counted among the Crown Worlds) a [[Noble/Legends|noble]] of House Indupar, [[Lady/Legends|Lady]] [[Kalena]], was captured by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Privateer/Legends|privateer]] [[Urias Xhaxin]] and held to ransom.
